## 5.2 Strict Product Liability for Persuasive Software

Within this new framework of doctrinal construction, the burden of proof (*onus probandi*) must be radically inverted. As contemporary jurists in the discourse of technological risk regulation emphasize, victims or their legal heirs should no longer bear the impossible obligation of dismantling black-box algorithms to pinpoint developer negligence (Article 1365 of the Indonesian Civil Code (*Burgerlijk Wetboek*); Hildebrandt, 2015).
